content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where conventional payment platforms are restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-step-step-6|Setting Up]] up online stores that accept crypto payments. This infrastructure [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/problem-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-how-solve|problem]] is not unique to Zimbabwe, as many platforms, including Stripe, are unavailable in several regions, leaving creators without a reliable means to sell their digital products. This guide will walk you through building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, leveraging the power of Stack 02, also known as the Edge Commerce Stack, to bypass these restrictions and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-honest-side|COREMERCH guide to start]] selling your digital products with ease.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The Edge Commerce Stack, comprising Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, offers a robust and scalable infrastructure for digital creators to host and sell their products. This stack is particularly beneficial for those in regions where traditional payment platforms are restricted, as it allows for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a low fee of 0.5%. By deploying this stack, creators can ensure they own their data and have full control over their store, without relying on third-party platforms that may impose restrictions or fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, you'll need to prepare a few essential components. First, ensure you have a clear understanding of the digital products you want to sell and their pricing. Next, set up a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto payments. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Pages and Supabase to understand how they will be used in your store's infrastructure. Having these elements in place will streamline the deployment process and ensure a smooth setup of your crypto store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With the Edge Commerce Stack, setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is straightforward. Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic, while Supabase stores order information. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly, allowing for automatic crypto payment verification. For file delivery, you can utilize Cloudflare's R2 storage or Google Drive, ensuring that your digital products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation. This pipeline is designed to be efficient, secure, and scalable, providing a solid foundation for your crypto store.
Deploy the Edge Commerce Stack in 48 hours with COREMERCH's deployment service.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your Edge Commerce Stack is deployed, going live and processing your first transaction is an exciting milestone. After configuring your store, loading your digital products, and testing the payment pipeline, you're ready to start selling. The first transaction is a significant test of your infrastructure, and with the Edge Commerce Stack, you can have confidence in its ability to handle payments securely and efficiently. As you start receiving payments, you'll appreciate the low 0.5% fee from NOWPayments and the ease of managing your store without third-party restrictions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your crypto store grows, scaling your infrastructure is crucial to maintain performance and reliability. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed to scale with your business, leveraging the powerful combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. By monitoring your store's performance and adjusting your infrastructure as needed, you can ensure that your store remains responsive and secure, even under increased traffic. Additionally, the scalability of the Edge Commerce Stack allows you to expand your product offerings and reach a wider audience, further growing your digital business.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can leverage the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This infrastructure provides a cost-effective and scalable solution, with the only fee being 0.5% per transaction through NOWPayments. By choosing this stack, you can bypass traditional payment platforms and their restrictions, gaining full control over your store and its operations.
Bypass traditional payment platforms and their restrictions with the Edge Commerce Stack.

For those interested in deploying the Edge Commerce Stack quickly, COREMERCH offers a deployment service within 48 hours. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes the deployment of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, along with the loading of 5 products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and end-to-end testing before handoff. You can find more details about this service and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you can explore how to build a robust and scalable crypto store that meets your needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store, start by setting up a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Next, configure Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Then, integrate Supabase for order storage and set up file delivery through Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. After loading your digital products, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security and test your store end-to-end to ensure everything is working as expected. Finally, go live and start processing transactions, monitoring your store's performance and scaling your infrastructure as your business grows.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?
Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, offering more advanced features and scalability.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages can be used to host a digital product store, with Cloudflare Pages offering more advanced features and better performance.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01 following the Sovereign Blueprint?
Stack 01 deployment typically takes 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, providing a quick start for digital creators.
What is the fee for using NOWPayments in the Edge Commerce Stack?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, with no KYC or buyer account required, making it an attractive option for crypto payments.
Is the Edge Commerce Stack scalable for growing businesses?

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack is designed to scale with your business, leveraging the powerful combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase to ensure your store remains responsive and secure under increased traffic.
